part.text:
Fixed the escaped closing brace handling.

`replacer.go:137` now also processes input containing an escaped `}` even when no `{` is present, so `\}` correctly unescapes to `}`. This makes `uri replace "\}" %7D` match the request's closing brace.

Validated:
- `go test . -run TestReplacer` passes
- `go test ./caddytest/integration -run "TestUriReplace|TestCaddyfileAdaptToJSON"` passes
- `caddyconfig/caddyfile`, `modules/caddyhttp/rewrite`, and root package tests pass

Full integration still has unrelated pre-existing ACME/TLS environment failures.
